exercises.question: Which sentence gives advice using the subjunctive? [¿Cuál da un consejo con subjuntivo?]
options: Es importante que comas de forma equilibrada. [It is important that you eat a balanced diet.]
Comes de forma equilibrada. [You eat a balanced diet.]
Comerás de forma equilibrada. [You will eat a balanced diet.]

exercises.sentence: Te recomiendo que __ el consumo de azúcar. [I recommend that you limit your sugar consumption.]
exercises.english: I recommend that you limit your sugar consumption.
It is better to choose nutritious foods when you have time to cook.

sentences: Es importante que comas de forma equilibrada. [It is important that you eat a balanced diet.]
Así tendrás más energía durante el día. [That way you will have more energy during the day.]
Por último, no tienes que cambiarlo todo de una vez. [Finally, you do not have to change everything at once.]

exercises.question: Which form completes «Te recomiendo que ___ el consumo de azúcar»? [¿Qué forma completa la frase?]
options: moderes [you limit]
moderas [you limit, indicative]
moderarás [you will limit]

exercises.sentence: Es importante que __ de forma equilibrada. [It is important that you eat a balanced diet.]
exercises.english: It is important that you eat a balanced diet.
You should prepare more food at home so that you have better control over what you eat.

exercises.sentence: Es importante que comas de forma equilibrada, aunque no tienes que cambiarlo todo de una vez.
options: It is important that you eat a balanced diet, although you do not have to change everything at once.
It is urgent that you change all your food habits right now without waiting any longer.
It is not important what you eat each day, as long as you cook all your meals at home.

exercises.sentence: Te recomiendo que moderes el consumo de azúcar porque puede afectar a tu salud.
options: I recommend that you limit your sugar consumption because it can affect your health.
I recommend increasing sugar because it improves health.
You should avoid all food because sugar is healthy.

exercises.sentence: Es mejor que elijas alimentos nutritivos cuando tengas tiempo para cocinar.
exercises.english: It is better to choose nutritious foods when you have time to cook.

exercises.sentence: Deberías preparar más comida en casa para que controles mejor lo que comes.
options: You should prepare more food at home so that you have better control over what you eat.
You should stop preparing food because it takes too little time.
You should eat out so that you control your ingredients.

prompt.speaker: A
prompt.text: ¿Qué me recomiendas si quiero comer mejor?

options: Te recomiendo que moderes el consumo de azúcar y que elijas alimentos nutritivos. [I recommend that you limit sugar and choose nutritious foods.]
Te recomiendo que moderas el consumo de azúcar y que eliges alimentos nutritivos. [I recommend that you limit (indicative) sugar and choose (indicative) nutritious foods.]
Te recomiendo que moderarás el consumo de azúcar y que elegirás alimentos nutritivos. [I recommend that you will limit sugar and will choose nutritious foods.]
No; es mejor que hagas cambios poco a poco para que puedas mantenerlos. [No; it is better to make changes gradually so that you can maintain them.]
No; es mejor que haces cambios poco a poco para que puedes mantenerlos. [No; it is better that you make (indicative) changes gradually so that you can (indicative) maintain them.]
No; es mejor que harás cambios poco a poco para que podrás mantenerlos. [No; it is better that you will make changes gradually so that you will be able to maintain them.]
Es mejor que elijas alimentos nutritivos y que mantengas una dieta equilibrada. [It is better to choose nutritious foods and maintain a balanced diet.]
Es mejor que eliges alimentos nutritivos y que mantienes una dieta equilibrada. [It is better that you choose (indicative) nutritious foods and maintain (indicative) a balanced diet.]
Es mejor que elegirás alimentos nutritivos y que mantendrás una dieta equilibrada. [It is better that you will choose nutritious foods and will maintain a balanced diet.]

template.prompt: Give two connected pieces of advice about eating better.
template.answer: Te recomiendo que moderes el consumo de azúcar y que elijas alimentos nutritivos porque así tendrás una dieta más equilibrada.

template.prompt: Give advice to someone who has little time to cook.
template.answer: Deberías preparar comida sencilla en casa cuando puedas, aunque no tienes que cocinar todos los días.
